Package dev.turboism.sdk.plugin

Interface PluginDescriptor

public interface PluginDescriptor
Read-only public contract of plugin metadata loaded from META-INF/turboism/plugin.json.

The descriptor describes a resolved plugin package; changing a returned value does not change installation, permissions, capabilities, or runtime policy. Capability declarations are not proof that a provider is available on the current host.
